from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        title_text = "The Change of Basis Matrix (P)"
        lecture_lines = [
            "- This translation is neatly handled by matrix multiplication.",
            "- We build matrix P using Pixel's basis vectors.",
            "- Each column of P is one of his vectors.",
            "- Multiplying P by Pixel's coordinates gives our coordinates.",
            "- P acts as a dictionary between these two languages."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)

        # Colors
        COLOR_B1 = "#FFFF00"  # Yellow
        COLOR_B2 = "#00FFFF"  # Cyan
        COLOR_HIGHLIGHT = YELLOW

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)
        
        # Initial P matrix with abstract variables
        matrix_p_raw = MathTex(
            "P = \\begin{bmatrix} p_{11} & p_{12} \\\\ p_{21} & p_{22} \\end{bmatrix}",
            color=WHITE
        )
        self.place_in_area(matrix_p_raw, "B3", "D5", scale_factor=1.2)
        self.play(Write(matrix_p_raw))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)
        
        # Show the actual basis vectors
        v1_tex = MathTex("\\vec{b}_1 = \\begin{bmatrix} 2 \\\\ 1 \\end{bmatrix}", color=COLOR_B1)
        v2_tex = MathTex("\\vec{b}_2 = \\begin{bmatrix} -1 \\\\ 1 \\end{bmatrix}", color=COLOR_B2)
        
        self.place_at_grid(v1_tex, "B1", scale_factor=0.7)
        self.place_at_grid(v2_tex, "E1", scale_factor=0.7)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(v1_tex), FadeIn(v2_tex))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)
        
        # Final numeric matrix with colors
        # We use separate strings in MathTex to control coloring easily
        matrix_p_final = MathTex(
            "P", "=", "\\begin{bmatrix}", "2", "&", "-1", "\\\\", "1", "&", "1", "\\end{bmatrix}",
            color=WHITE
        )
        # Apply colors to columns (indices based on string split)
        # 0: P, 1: =, 2: \begin, 3: 2, 4: &, 5: -1, 6: \\, 7: 1, 8: &, 9: 1, 10: \end
        matrix_p_final[3].set_color(COLOR_B1) # 2
        matrix_p_final[7].set_color(COLOR_B1) # 1
        matrix_p_final[5].set_color(COLOR_B2) # -1
        matrix_p_final[9].set_color(COLOR_B2) # 1
        
        self.place_in_area(matrix_p_final, "B3", "D5", scale_factor=1.2)
        
        # Animate the transition: vectors "becoming" the columns
        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(matrix_p_raw, matrix_p_final),
            v1_tex.animate.move_to(self.grid["C3"]).scale(0.1).set_opacity(0),
            v2_tex.animate.move_to(self.grid["C4"]).scale(0.1).set_opacity(0),
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)
        
        # Equation x = P [x]_B
        equation = MathTex(
            "\\vec{x} = P [\\vec{x}]_B",
            color=WHITE
        )
        self.place_in_area(equation, "A2", "A5", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        # concrete multiplication: [3, 3]^T = P [2, 1]^T
        calc_eq = MathTex(
            "\\begin{bmatrix} 3 \\\\ 3 \\end{bmatrix}", "=",
            "\\begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 \\\\ 1 & 1 \\end{bmatrix}",
            "\\begin{bmatrix} 2 \\\\ 1 \\end{bmatrix}",
            color=WHITE
        )
        # Color matrix columns in the calculation (index 2 of calc_eq)
        # calc_eq[2] is the matrix. Manim parses its sub-elements.
        # [ (0), 2 (1), & (2), - (3), 1 (4), \\ (5), 1 (6), & (7), 1 (8), ] (9)
        calc_eq[2][1].set_color(COLOR_B1)
        calc_eq[2][6].set_color(COLOR_B1)
        calc_eq[2][3].set_color(COLOR_B2)
        calc_eq[2][4].set_color(COLOR_B2)
        calc_eq[2][8].set_color(COLOR_B2)
        
        # Color the coordinate vector
        calc_eq[3].set_color(LIGHT_PINK)
        
        self.place_in_area(calc_eq, "F1", "F6", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(Write(equation))
        self.play(FadeIn(calc_eq))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)
        
        # Label P as a 'Dictionary'
        dict_label = Text("Dictionary", font_size=24, color=COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)
        self.place_at_grid(dict_label, "E5", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        # Draw arrow from label to matrix P
        arrow = Arrow(dict_label.get_left(), matrix_p_final.get_right(), color=COLOR_HIGHLIGHT, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(Create(arrow), Write(dict_label))
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # Background and Title
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=32, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content
        self.lecture_items = VGroup()
        for line in lecture_lines:
            dot = Dot(color=WHITE, radius=0.04)
            text = Text(line, font_size=20, color=WHITE)
            item = GrowingStackedMobjects(dot, text) # Conceptual grouping
            # Simplified grouping for reliable rendering
            full_line = Text(line, font_size=20, color=WHITE)
            self.lecture_items.add(full_line)
        
        self.lecture_items.arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4)
        self.lecture_items.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5).shift(DOWN * 0.5)
        self.add(self.lecture_items)

        # Interaction Area (Right Side)
        # We'll define a center for the right side to place objects
        self.right_area_center = RIGHT * 3 + DOWN * 0.5

    def highlight_line(self, index):
        animations = []
        for i, item in enumerate(self.lecture_items):
            if i == index:
                animations.append(item.animate.set_color(YELLOW).set_opacity(1))
            else:
                animations.append(item.animate.set_color(WHITE).set_opacity(0.3))
        return animations

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        title_text = "The Change of Basis Matrix (P)"
        lecture_lines = [
            "This translation uses matrix multiplication.",
            "We build matrix P using Pixel's basis vectors.",
            "Each column of P is one of his vectors.",
            "Multiplying P by Pixel's coordinates gives ours.",
            "P acts as a dictionary between languages."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)

        # Colors
        COLOR_B1 = YELLOW
        COLOR_B2 = CYAN
        
        # 1. Show abstract matrix P
        self.play(*self.highlight_line(0))
        matrix_p_raw = MathTex(
            "P = \\begin{bmatrix} p_{11} & p_{12} \\\\ p_{21} & p_{22} \\end{bmatrix}",
            font_size=42
        ).move_to(self.right_area_center)
        self.play(Write(matrix_p_raw))
        self.wait(1.5)

        # 2. Show basis vectors
        self.play(*self.highlight_line(1))
        v1_tex = MathTex("\\vec{b}_1 = \\begin{bmatrix} 2 \\\\ 1 \\end{bmatrix}", color=COLOR_B1, font_size=34)
        v2_tex = MathTex("\\vec{b}_2 = \\begin{bmatrix} -1 \\\\ 1 \\end{bmatrix}", color=COLOR_B2, font_size=34)
        
        vectors_vgroup = VGroup(v1_tex, v2_tex).arrange(RIGHT, buff=1).next_to(matrix_p_raw, UP, buff=1)
        self.play(FadeIn(v1_tex), FadeIn(v2_tex))
        self.wait(1.5)

        # 3. Form the numeric matrix P
        self.play(*self.highlight_line(2))
        # Construction of matrix P with colored entries
        matrix_p_final = MathTex(
            "P", "=", "\\begin{bmatrix}", "2", "&", "-1", "\\\\", "1", "&", "1", "\\end{bmatrix}",
            font_size=42
        ).move_to(self.right_area_center)
        
        # Color specific parts: index 3 and 7 are col 1, index 5 and 9 are col 2
        matrix_p_final[3].set_color(COLOR_B1) # 2
        matrix_p_final[7].set_color(COLOR_B1) # 1
        matrix_p_final[5].set_color(COLOR_B2) # -1
        matrix_p_final[9].set_color(COLOR_B2) # 1

        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(matrix_p_raw, matrix_p_final),
            v1_tex.animate.scale(0.5).move_to(matrix_p_final[3].get_center()).set_opacity(0),
            v2_tex.animate.scale(0.5).move_to(matrix_p_final[5].get_center()).set_opacity(0),
        )
        self.wait(1.5)

        # 4. Show the equation x = P [x]_B
        self.play(*self.highlight_line(3))
        equation = MathTex(
            "\\vec{x} = P [\\vec{x}]_B",
            font_size=40, color=WHITE
        ).next_to(matrix_p_final, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        calc_example = MathTex(
            "\\begin{bmatrix} 3 \\\\ 3 \\end{bmatrix}", "=",
            "\\begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 \\\\ 1 & 1 \\end{bmatrix}",
            "\\begin{bmatrix} 2 \\\\ 1 \\end{bmatrix}",
            font_size=34
        ).next_to(equation, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        
        # Color the calculation P matrix columns
        # Index 2 is the matrix in calc_example
        calc_example[2][1].set_color(COLOR_B1) # 2
        calc_example[2][3].set_color(COLOR_B2) # -
        calc_example[2][4].set_color(COLOR_B2) # 1
        calc_example[2][6].set_color(COLOR_B1) # 1
        calc_example[2][8].set_color(COLOR_B2) # 1
        
        self.play(Write(equation))
        self.play(FadeIn(calc_example, shift=UP * 0.2))
        self.wait(1.5)

        # 5. Summary Label
        self.play(*self.highlight_line(4))
        dict_label = Text("Dictionary Matrix", font_size=24, color=YELLOW)
        dict_label.next_to(matrix_p_final, RIGHT, buff=0.5)
        arrow = Arrow(dict_label.get_left(), matrix_p_final.get_right(), color=YELLOW)
        
        self.play(Create(arrow), Write(dict_label))
        self.wait(3)
